blocks.html: The CoolSculpting® procedure is the only FDA-cleared non-surgical fat reduction treatment that uses controlled cooling to safely target and reduce diet and exercise resistant body fat.

At Victory MedSpa, we often see men and women who are dissatisfied with the look of their bodies. Many of our patients have adopted the healthy lifestyle habits prevalent in Austin They frequently not only have a normal body weight range, but even with diet and exercise, struggle to lose their love handles or belly fat. The accumulation of where body fat is distributed is sometimes out of your control.

Body fat can be accumulated due to a variety of factors such as age, hormones, lifestyle, and life in general. As we age, our hormone levels decrease which causes fat cells to expand. At Victory MedSpa, we will develop a customized CoolSculpting® treatment plan that means your needs and addresses your problem areas.

CoolSculpting® in Austin gently targets fat cells underneath the skin while keeping surrounding tissues safe. During a typical CoolSculpting® treatment, a handheld device is placed on treated areas and the controlled cooling is administered, freezing underlying fat. These cells are then permanently disabled and are gradually removed by the body through natural processes.

When Will I See My CoolSculpting® Results?

blocks.html: CoolSculpting® results are not instantaneous so if you are wanting to have the procedure done before a vacation, you need to plan. However, the results are long lasting. You may start to see changes as soon as three weeks after your treatment. Most patients see the best results after 2-3 months.
